name: Knittelsheim (Germany)
description: Quartered white and blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Knittelsheim (a blue horseshoe with plants on white).
history: Municipal flag of Knittelsheim; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Knittelsheim arms — horseshoe with plants on white
